items.title: Are Your Dividends Safe? 4 Companies Whose Debt Is Competing With the Payout
items.summary: Bondholders get paid first, and shareholders get whatever the board leaves behind. Four high-yield stocks, from a hospital landlord to a telecom giant, are now squeezed between rising interest costs and the checks sent to investors. Which payout bends first?

items.summary: AT&T (NYSE:T) plans to handle all consumer-facing customer support through U.S.-based operations by 2027 as part of a reshoring push. Management is framing the shift as aligned with emerging federal policy and regulatory expectations around domestic customer service operations.
